A little slime care

Love your slime and it will love you back.

♡ Keep it clean

Wash your hands before playing. Keep slime away from dirt, food, makeup, and fabrics.

❄️ Store it right

Keep slime sealed in its container in a cool, dry place away from heat and direct sunlight.

✨ Adjust the texture

If slime feels firm, gently knead in a tiny drop of vegetable glycerine. If it feels sticky, add a little slime activator at a time, following the product's care instructions.

✦ Shop owner studio — add, edit & manage products

Add product photos, update details and prices, or remove items. Your edits are saved in this browser on this device. To make changes visible to every customer on a live website, you’ll need to publish/connect a website platform.
